You: So. What are your thoughts about the new pope? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: New pope? You mean Pius XXX?
You: No... {{wi}}There’s a new one. Goku the second. I read about it on the news.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Forgive me, but it seems that my database is out of date.{{wi}} I need to go back to my station to check for new updates. I invite you to ask more questions after ESTIMATED TIME REMAINING, 12 HOURS. {{wi}}Thank you for understanding. {{wi}}Goodbye.
